scope: Sequential tiny then medium in the same official SDK worker runner. Three fixed crops selected for known tiny-reader errors, followed by the same four familiar development receipts (five whole-image panels). Crops are not independent receipts or a holdout. Original fifty untouched. No labels or earlier OCR supplied to either recognizer. Model caches reused without writing new weight archives. No new app default or provider integration.

controller.startup_guard_basis: Prior sampled medium browser tree peak plus 1 GiB reserve, identical for both study arms
controller.scope: Experimental single-browser resource guard, not a vendor requirement or guarantee of peak memory fit. Local synthetic input plus optional fixed receipt cohort. Observer is a sibling, process tree contains development tools and browser, not model-only memory or a phone measurement.

tiny.memory_scope: Peak sampled sum of the caller-selected owned root and observed descendants. A Node root includes its browser and native children; a Python worker root excludes its unrelated browser/Node parent. 250ms sampling can miss short-lived children. GPU and unrelated-process memory are excluded; per-process OS peaks are separate.

The frozen browser route blocks external requests and non-GET/HEAD requests throughout; no external private upload or secret access was enabled.
